CoupleRoom.title: CoupleRoom
CoupleRoom.description: Represents a private real-time synchronized session linking two partners via a Room Code.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of Partner 1 (room creator).

partner2Id.description: Firebase Auth UID of Partner 2 (empty string until joined).

lastPulseBy.description: UID of the partner who most recently sent a longing pulse.

lastPulseFromName.description: Display name of the partner who sent the last pulse.

lastPulseMessage.description: Short romantic message attached to the pulse.

lastPulseAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the last pulse trigger.

activeCardId.description: ID of the currently drawn card.

activeCardTitle.description: Title of the currently drawn card.

activeCardText.description: Prompt text of the currently drawn card.

activeCardLevel.description: Deck level (1, 2, or 3) of the active card.

activeCardPoints.description: Reward points for completing the active card.

activeCardDrawnBy.description: Display name of the partner who drew the card.

activeCardFlipped.description: Whether the drawn card is currently flipped face-up on both screens.

activeCardStage.description: Current stage of the card slot.

wheelOptions.description: List of options on the synchronized spin wheel (max 20).

wheelSpinAngle.description: Target cumulative rotation angle in degrees for synchronized wheel spin.

wheelSpinning.description: Whether the wheel is actively spinning.

wheelWinner.description: Selected option after the spin finishes.

wheelSpunBy.description: Name of the partner who triggered the wheel spin.

wheelSpinTimestamp.description: Epoch ms when the wheel spin started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last room update.

WrittenGoal.title: WrittenGoal
WrittenGoal.description: A written goal, evening target, or secret desire shared between partners on the live board.

roomId.description: Room code this goal belongs to.

authorId.description: UID of the partner who wrote the goal.

authorName.description: Display name of the goal author.

visibilityMode.description: Whether visible immediately or hidden/blurred until revealed.

isRevealed.description: True if the goal is visible or has been revealed by the partner.

rewardPoints.description: Points awarded upon completing the goal.

memberUids.description: Array of authorized partner UIDs in this room (max 2).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when goal was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when goal was last updated.

CustomCard.title: CustomCard
CustomCard.description: A secret custom card added by either partner to one of the 3 game levels.

roomId.description: Room code this card belongs to.

authorId.description: UID of the partner who created the card.

authorName.description: Name of the partner who created the card.

points.description: Points awarded when card is completed.

memberUids.description: Authorized partner UIDs in this room (max 2).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when card was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when card was updated.

StoreReward.title: StoreReward
StoreReward.description: A custom reward in the couple's Love Points store.

roomId.description: Room code this reward belongs to.

authorId.description: UID of the partner who added the reward.

authorName.description: Display name of the partner who created the reward.

description.description: Details of what the reward entails.

costPoints.description: Love points required to redeem this reward.

redeemedCount.description: Number of times this reward has been redeemed.

lastRedeemedBy.description: Display name of the partner who last redeemed this reward.

memberUids.description: Authorized partner UIDs in this room (max 2).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reward was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when reward was updated.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Stores real-time couple room state, partner moods, longing pulses, active 3D card flip state, and synchronized spin wheel state.

/rooms/{roomId}/goals/{goalId}.description: Stores live written goals and secret desires for the couple room.

/rooms/{roomId}/cards/{cardId}.description: Stores custom secret cards added by either partner into any of the 3 levels.

/rooms/{roomId}/rewards/{rewardId}.description: Stores custom redeemable rewards in the couple's Love Points store.
